title: Isolation of Cardiac Myocytes and Measurement of Myocyte Shortening
author: Gustavo Marchini
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7z6hp9e
materials: In the software Ionwizard (IonOptix, USA), align edge detection bars to each end of myocyte and adjust threshold for contractility measurement with myocyte length variation.

Still in the software, align sarcomere detection on an area of cell with uniform sarcomeres. Choose a longer bar in the longitudinal axis to include as many sarcomeres as possible and improve contractility measurement with sarcomere length variation.
Heat and maintain the buffers solutions with different Ca 2+ concentrations (50 µM, 200 µM, 500 µM, 1 mM) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Base Buffer and Calcium Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the primary buffer and stock calcium solutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 400 mL of buffer solution and adjust pH to 7.4 using NaOH.
Prepare 10 mL of 500 mM CaCl2 solution.
Prepare 50 mL of 100 mM CaCl2 solution.

steps.title: Prepare Specific Calcium Buffer Concentrations
steps.instruction: Create a series of buffer solutions with varying Ca2+ concentrations by adding stock CaCl2 to the base buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.25 mM Ca2+ buffer: Add 0.5 mL of 500 mM CaCl2 to 200 mL of buffer.
Prepare 50 µM Ca2+ buffer: Add 25 µL of 100 mM CaCl2 to 50 mL of buffer.
Prepare 100 µM Ca2+ buffer: Add 15 µL of 100 mM CaCl2 to 15 mL of buffer.
Prepare 200 µM Ca2+ buffer: Add 30 µL of 100 mM CaCl2 to 15 mL of buffer.
Prepare 500 µM Ca2+ buffer: Add 75 µL of 100 mM CaCl2 to 15 mL of buffer.
Prepare 1 mM Ca2+ buffer: Add 150 µL of 100 mM CaCl2 to 15 mL of buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Digestion Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the enzyme solution and store it at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mg of type II collagenase to 40 mL of buffer solution containing 20 µM Ca2+.

steps.title: Set Up Langendorff Apparatus
steps.instruction: Assemble and prime the perfusion system.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the constant flow Langendorff apparatus using a peristaltic pump, tubing, cannula, and a heat exchanger coil.
Connect the exchanger coil to a circulating water bath set at 37 °C.
Connect a thermometer to the outflow to monitor the heated solution temperature.
Fill the apparatus with pre-heated 1.25 mM Ca2+ buffer solution, eliminating all air bubbles.
Set the peristaltic pump flow rate to 5.5 mL/min at the cannula outflow.

steps.title: Prepare and Excise Heart
steps.instruction: Administer medications and surgically remove the heart from the animal.

substeps.instruction: Inject mouse with heparin solution (5000 U/Kg) via intraperitoneal injection.
After 30 min, anesthetize rat with a single intraperitoneal injection of sodium thiopental (50 mg/kg).
Verify anesthesia (no response to strong foot pinch) and euthanize by cervical dislocation.
Open the chest, identify the aorta, and excise the heart carefully.
Immediately place the heart in pre-oxygenated 1.25 mM Ca2+ buffer solution at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perfuse and Digest Heart
steps.instruction: Perform sequential perfusion steps to isolate myocytes.

substeps.instruction: Cannulate the heart via the aorta in the Langendorff system and secure with a silk suture loop.
Perfuse with 1.25 mM Ca2+ buffer at 5.5 mL/min for 10 min.
Switch to Ca2+-free buffer and perfuse at 7.5 mL/min for 5 min.
Switch to digestion buffer and perfuse at 7.5 mL/min for 5 min.
Recirculate the enzyme solution until the heart becomes flaccid and pale (approximately 20–30 minutes).

steps.title: Isolate and Wash Myocytes
steps.instruction: Mechanically disperse the cells and perform a graded calcium wash.

substeps.instruction: Place the heart in a petri dish with 50 µM Ca2+ buffer, cut into small chunks, and pipette several times to disperse cells.
Filter the suspension through a 250 μm nylon mesh filter into two 15 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge the suspension for 3 minutes at 35g.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 µM Ca2+ buffer.
Allow cells to pellet for 10 min, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend in 200 µM Ca2+ buffer.
Repeat the pelleting and resuspension process until cells are in 1 mM Ca2+ buffer.

steps.title: Set Up Myocyte Shortening Measurement
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to the recording chamber and configure the stimulator.

substeps.instruction: Add drops of the cell suspension to a C-Stim chamber (IonOptix, USA).
Set the syringe pump to perfuse 1 mM Ca2+ buffer into the chamber at 1 mL/min.
Set the temperature controller to 37 °C for the chamber inlet and attach vacuum aspiration to the outlet.
Use a 40X objective to locate a healthy, rod-shaped cell that is not spontaneously contracting.
Adjust camera rotation to align the cell horizontally on the screen.
Set the electrical stimulator for bipolar pulses: 5 ms pulse duration, 25 V pulse amplitude, and 1 Hz frequency.

steps.title: Record Cell Contractions
steps.instruction: Stimulate the cells and capture data.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the electrical stimulator to pace the cells.
Record the tracing for posterior analysis.
